mcp.title: MCP Server
mcp.subtitle: Give your AI agents access to the HeyCSS styles catalog via the Model Context Protocol.
mcp.endpointDesc: Connect any MCP client (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to this Streamable HTTP endpoint.
mcp.mcpDesc: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets AI assistants call tools hosted in external servers. This server exposes the HeyCSS style presets as searchable tools, so an agent can browse, search and retrieve ready-to-use CSS — box-shadows, borders, text effects and shapes — directly in your workflow.
mcp.toolListDesc: Browse the catalog by category (boxShadow, border, text, shape) with pagination.
mcp.toolSearchDesc: Search presets by name, tag or description in English or Chinese.
mcp.toolGetDesc: Fetch a single preset's full CSS by tab and id.
